programme.title: Episodio 8
programme.desc: La maldad de Katiuska no da tregua: finge amistad mientras tortura a Manuela con llamadas anónimas desde su propia casa. El matrimonio de Ricardo pende de un hilo tras una explosiva pelea por un cofre violado. Paralelamente, Graciela abandona a Marcelo dejándolo desolado. El terror azota a Celia al recibir cartas que amenazan con secuestrar a Elizabeth. La tragedia acecha cuando Manuela, en medio de la reconciliación, sufre un misterioso dolor en el vientre que lo cambiará todo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 204: El Secreto de Cristina Revelado
programme.desc: Cristina confiesa a Egleé que está esperando un hijo de Gerson. Ambas lloran y después Egleé va a comunicar la noticia a Gladis sobre sus hijos. La noticia del embarazo de Cristina empieza a correr como pólvora. Santiago se desahoga con Matilde.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 205: Romulo exige responsabilidad por el embarazo
programme.desc: La noticia del embarazo de Cristina causa revuelo y tanto Gladis como Rómulo están muy molestos con sus respectivos hijos. Después, muy molesto va Rómulo a casa de Gladis para enfrentar a Gerson y exigirle que se responsabilice de su nueva paternidad.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 206: Doroteo, Maria Antonia y Aristiguieta
programme.desc: Doroteo entra al baño de María Antonia mientras ella se baña, pero para sorpresa de ambos, llega Aristiguieta y ellos intentan evadirlo. Por otro lado, la abogada sorprende en la mentira a Theo y le urge que llegue para aclarar las cosas.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 207: Corazon Roto, Sospechas y Maternidad
programme.desc: Santiago está borracho y escuchando mariachi por el corazón roto, pero repentinamente llega Egleé para desahogarse porque cree que es mala madre. Por un momento Aristiguieta sospecha que Felicita y Gonzalo estuvieron juntos de viaje en Orlando.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 208: Calzones y el Regreso de Gonzalo
programme.desc: María Antonia encuentra unos calzones de hombre en la maleta de Tatiana y monta en cólera, pero ella se justifica diciendo que son de su amiga. Matilde está muy preocupada porque Gonzalo regresa a la oficina e inevitablemente sabrá lo de Moncho.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol no logra entender cómo su bebé no es un varón, sino una niña. Cree que hubo algún error en la clínica; mientras que Aída se siente culpable por ocultarle a Alejandro la verdadera paternidad de su bebé. Reina le confiesa a Alejandro que ha ordenado tomar muestras de ADN a sus hijos recién nacidos, para así asegurar la paternidad de Alejandro. Él lo acepta sin reproches. luego, se lo comunica a Sol y Aída, pero Aída parece realmente ofendida y molesta por la situación.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Aída quiere decirle algo muy importante a Sol y Reina se interpone. En ese momento llega Heriberto con la noticia de que Sol está libre por decisión del juez. Y le dice a Reina que él y Sol se van a vivir juntos. Maricielo encuentra a su padre infraganti en un bar con su amante. Ella pone el grito en el cielo y decide volver a vivir a lo de su madre junto a Torombolo, Bárbara y Eloycito. Ramón se opone rotundamente al casamiento entre Alicia y Carlucho.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El doctor le entrega a Alejandro los resultados del examen de ADN que se hizo para determinar si era padre tanto del hijo de Aída como del de Sol. Ya que las pruebas que él leyó determinaban que el hijo de Sol no es suyo, él la visita para decirle que no quiere verla nunca más. Sol aprovecha este alejamiento de Alejandro para evitar tener problemas al confrontar a su madre. Pero le duele mucho eso ya que sabe que no es verdad, que él es el padre de su hijo y que Reina cambió las pruebas de ADN.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol y Reina discuten en el hospital y Sol le promete que se vengará de ella y de lo que le hizo. Ricarda se encuentra feliz de que su hija está viva. Al día siguiente va con el comisario Tavares y la policía al campamento de los maleantes que tiene secuestrada a Giselle y Tavares los reduce uno a uno. Eloy le dice a Columba que no puede divorciarse de Reina. Aída se da cuenta de que le cambiaron su bebé con el de Sol y acusa a Reina en su cara. Reina la golpea y la amenaza.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Aída sabe que el bebé que tiene no es de ella y que Reina lo intercambió por el de Sol. La situación la tiene muy mal y no puede hacer nada porque Reina la tiene amenazada y la acusa de ser su cómplice. Sol y Heriberto han decidido casarse e irse a vivir junto bajo el mismo techo. Sol se entera de que la mansión de los Monserrat antiguamente pertenecía a los Figueras y por lo tanto ahora le pertenece a ella. Sol, está decidida a recuperar lo que le corresponde. Eloy y Columba se pelean.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: La discusión que tienen Wilker y Yubiri hace prever que se acabó toda relación entre ellos. Solymar está envuelta en sus pensamientos con Wilker y Yubiri. Juan Diego la saluda y esta comienza a hablarle maravillas de Yubiri. El se va y ella se queda pensando que casi se la vende En el gimnasio están todas incluyendo a Gisela hablando de las figuras y las figuras con barriga. El Junior trata de inventarle a Jesica que Briggite no se quiere divorciar de él. Olegario se muere de la risa.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite monta en cólera en el consultorio del ginecólogo. No puede creer que esté menopáusica. Pero el doctor la quita del error. Es una etapa que finaliza pero otra comienza. El Doctor Caridad insulta a junior y le dice que si él no le dice a Jesica hoy que su esposa está embarazada | se lo dice él y que no quiere hablar más del matrimonio. Junior está feliz y pensando en regresar hoy mismo para su casa. ROKUro y Dionisia se despiden hasta una próxima vez.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri y Wilker siguen debajo de la lluvia. Ella le dice que vayan al gimnasio para secarse el acepta. Finita | Ana y Briggite están almorzando en un restaurante. Finita y Ana le dicen que Yubiri le está serruchando el puesto y además quitándole el novio a la hija. Briggite les informa que tiene la menopausia. En la casa de Fabián están Pastor | Olegario y Junior hablando de la menopausia de Briggite. Todos están de acuerdo que obligatoriamente tiene que casarse con Jesica.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: La Discusión con Atanasio la dejó muy mal parada. Atanasio dijo que no tenía nada que contarle a ella | que iba a esperar que llegara Briggite y lo resolvería a ese nivel. Juan Diego la invita a un café para que le cuente a él. Carolina ya está obstinada de esperar a Juan Diego. Segundo llega en su taxi nuevo y la lleva. Juan Diego trata de tranquilizar a Yubiri y esta ya ni se acuerda del problema. Carolina se va con Segundo y este le dice que van a ir a una panadería a comer cachitos.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Brigitte se sorprende porque Ana y Finita le cuentan que se enteraron que el Junior se va a casar con una adolescente. No lo puede creer | por lo que Ana le propone a Finita | que trate de averiguar a traves de Botero dónde está viviendo el Junior | que ella tratará de sacarle lo que sea a Olegario. Brigitte sigue insistiendo en que no puede ser posible que el Junior la va a dejar por una muchachita más joven que ella y entonces Finita y Ana les recuerdan que no fue él el que la dejó sino ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Trinidad llega junto a Zulay, Sandra y sus amigos, para ver que su casa ha sido desordenada completamente. Nada de valor se encontraba allí, por lo que sospechan que ha sido para buscar los documentos de Virginia. María Lucía escucha a Trinidad y a Virginia hablando sobre su secreto, y las confronta para saberlo, pero ellas se niegan completamente. Más tarde llega Zulay, y pretende contarle a Virginia sobre la propuesta de trabajo de Rodrigo, pero Trinidad las ve justo a tiempo. Jorge le cuenta la verdad sobre el embarazo de Oriana a Leo, y él corre a contárselo a María Lucía. Keka cae enferma con una fiebre muy alta, aparentemente una somatización causada por extrañar a Irene.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene llega a la casa de Leonardo para asistir a Rebeca por la fiebre que está sufriendo. Agustina se pone en su camino y le prohíbe la entrada, argumentando que Leonardo dijo explícitamente que no la dejara pasar nadie a Irene. Ella termina subiendo con el permiso de la señora Jimena. A Rebeca se le cura la fiebre por la alegría que le causa la presencia de Irene. Leonardo e Irene tienen un encontronazo en el que él intenta convencerla de que vuelva a su casa. Leo va a buscar a María Lucía para informarle que Oriana finalmente no está embarazada y para confesarle su amor. Julio, su hermano, se enfada con Leo e intenta impedir que hable a solas con María Lucía.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Virginia le confirma a su madre, Trinidad, de que va a trabajar en Ferrándiz. Trinidad no lo acepta de ninguna manera. Rebeca se cura gracias a la asistencia de Irene, que, a su vez se reconcilia con Leonardo. La señora Jimena se entera por su hijo que Virginia va a trabajar en la empresa, reniega de eso y va a solicitar un impedimento legal para que ella no se pueda acercar a su familia. Julio se pelea con su hermano Leonardo por causa del embarazo supuestamente falso de Oriana y le cuenta a su padre que Leonardo se reconcilió con María Lucía. Virginia se encuentra en la oficina con Rodrigo, alguien del pasado, que trata de abusar de ella. María Lucía, que se había reconciliado con Leonardo, queda desilusionada por la pelea que él tuvo con Ricardo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Las amigas de Nora le toman fotos a Javier Macías con Rosario y le proponen que contrate a los mariachis con Rosario para el cumpleaños de Javier. Por otro lado, Eulalia le prohíbe a Emiliano acercarse a Virginia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: La amiga de Nora llama al Bar Plaza Garibaldi para pedir una serenata que incluya a Rosario. Por otro lado, Virginia insiste en buscar a Emiliano y conquistarlo, pero este le dice que no quiere nada con nadie distinto a Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario sufre al pensar que Emiliano y Virginia tienen una relación a escondidas y es así como le pide a don Carlos que le consiga un reemplazo pues quiere renunciar. Por otro lado, los mariachis llegan a la fiesta de Javier Macías cantando.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le pide a Rosario que aclaren lo que paso entre ellos y la invita a la pensión. Por otro lado, Javier Macías decide irse de su casa por el escándalo que hizo Nora. La oferta laboral que había conseguido Javier para Rosario ha sido cancelada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Al enterarse que Rosario perdió un examen, Emiliano decide hablar con Raquel y le confiesa lo que paso con Macías. Por otro lado, Macías llega al Bar Garibaldi a disculparse e intenta pagar la serenata pero los mariachis lo echan sin recibir nada.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Gracias a Rosario, Emiliano logra superar la prueba del coloso en tarima. Tras salir del bar, Fernando convence a Emiliano de ir a una comisaría y poner un denuncio por perdida de documentos. Por otro lado, Martin y Steve salen de la cárcel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Tras salir de la cárcel, Steve y Martin se van a celebrar al apartamento de Corona donde se encuentran con Cristina. Por otro lado, Virginia y sus amigas planean contratar una serenata con el grupo de mariachis para hacerle otra encerrona a Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los mariachis llegan a dar la serenata y se sorprenden al ver que fue contratada por Virginia. Mientras tanto, Rosario busca a Sigifredo para informarle que su hija va a dar a luz. Rosario se llevará una gran sorpresa al ver a Virginia con Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo recibe a su nieta en el hospital junto a su esposa y Rosario. Por otro lado, Raquel no para de recordar a Pedro mientras ve a Emiliano sentado en el andén esperando a Rosario y vestido con el mismo traje que era de él.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Thomas les pone plazo de un mes a Corona y a Steve para que paguen los cinco millones de dólares que les decomisó la policía. Por otro lado, Daniela y Laura no le devuelven el sombrero a Emiliano, Virginia prefiere entregarle el sombrero a Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Duelo de rancheras en el escenario del Plaza Garibaldi, Rosario y Emiliano se retan con canciones sin medir las consecuencias. Los juegos de Virginia continúan funcionando para separar a Emiliano de Rosario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo cree que Emiliano debe arreglar las cosas con Rosario por las buenas y es por esto que deciden llevarle una serenata para pedir perdón. Por otro lado, Felipe Romero se hunde con las declaraciones que hace en la audiencia.

Gilles Lellouche interpreta Mathieu, um diplomata carismático e dedicado que aceita um posto em Irkutsk como diretor da Aliança Francesa na Sibéria. Ele espera que a mudança beneficie sua família e seu casamento em crise, mas logo sua organização de eventos culturais e apoio à expressão artística o colocam em rota de colisão com as autoridades locais. programme.desc: Un empleado de floristería crea una especie nueva de planta carnívora que desarrolla hábitos alimenticios poco comunes: tiene que alimentarla con su sangre. Pero su apetito y tamaño, crecerá, viéndose forzado a asesinar para satisfacerla.

programme.title: Adios a las armas
programme.desc: En la 1ª Guerra Mundial, un teniente americano herido, es trasladado a un hospital, donde inicia una relación con una enfermera británica. Este amor tendrá que luchar contra todas las adversidades de la guerra, que los separará inevitablemente.

programme.title: La última vez que vi París
programme.desc: Tras el término de la 2ª Guerra Mundial, Charles regresa a París, donde rememora los tiempos en que aspiraba a ser escritor y donde se enamoró de una joven que hizo su mujer. Poco a poco, como mejora su situación económica, decide escribir una novela…

programme.title: Fria Como Un Diamante
programme.desc: Un investigador de seguros se enamora de una joven y rica belleza cuando sospecha que ella puede estar involucrada en la venta de joyas robadas.

programme.title: ¡Vaya par de Soldados!
programme.desc: Korwin, un personaje torpe y Puccinelli un Don Juan e incorregible mujeriego, se alistan en la armada, donde se ven envueltos en multitud de problemas provocados por el primero, originando el caos en la base militar.

programme.title: El tercer Hombre

programme.title: Al Fin Solos
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes amigos que tocan la trompeta en la banda de la universidad, ven alterada su amistad por Ellen, el nuevo manager de la misma. Su rivalidad se extenderá entonces, al terreno del amor.

programme.title: Departamento Q: O Efeito Marco
programme.desc: O detetive Carl Mørck e seu assistente Assad investigam a história de um menino de 12 anos chamado Marco que foi detido na fronteira dinamarquesa e que é a chave para descobrir uma rede de corrupção internacional. A franquia de filmes "Departamento Q" é baseada no best-seller de Jussi Adler Olsen.

programme.title: Profissão de Risco
programme.desc: Jack é contratado por Dragna, um chefão do crime, para realizar uma tarefa aparentemente inocente: ele deve levar uma mala para um motel em Nova Orleans e esperar que ela seja recolhida. Mas Jack nunca conseguirá abrir a mala. Mas, no momento em que ele entra no motel, sua vida está em risco. Vários criminosos tentam tirar a bolsa dele e Jack precisa defendê-la se quiser viver.

programme.title: Outra Vida
programme.desc: Uma cientista desenvolve uma droga revolucionária que induz realidades virtuais e expande a sensação de tempo. Quando o governo tenta assumir projeto, ela precisará decidir como usar sua poderosa criação.

programme.title: Go For Sisters
programme.desc: Fontayne é recrutada por Bernice - sua antiga amiga, com quem estava afastada, e atual agente de liberdade condicional - juntamente com um policial desonrado, para procurar o filho de Bernice, que desapareceu na fronteira mexicana.

programme.title: Operações Especiais
programme.desc: Dois ex-agentes de operações secretas precisam transferir duas detentas para uma prisão. No caminho, são atacados por desconhecidos.

programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.desc: The focus has shifted, with parts having arrived at the shop it’s time to install the Grill, Bumper, Dash and Interior of our 1968 Turbine Bronze Charger. Mark and the Ghouls work their magic on the Charger until a familiar face shows up. With Royal there, Mark shifts the crew back to the 1 of 2 1970 Coronet and finishes the interior. Then, it’s time for a test drive!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. Mark’s 1964 A100 Hemi truck, the Little Dead Wagon, built as an homage to Bill Maverick’s Little Red Wagon. Will is set to prime and paint, but has a disagreement with Mark over the color. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. Brakes, suspension, tail lights, bed sealer, you name it and the Mopar Maniacs are racing to get it done. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. Installing all of the final components is an all hands on deck task and when the dust settles, Mark has only the decals left to put on the car, completing its legendary look. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: When Mark get’s started talking about a car there is almost no stopping him. So it is again when Mark picks multiple years of a favorite Mopar of his and tells both the audience, and whoever will listen all about their amazing options and cool differences. The Ghouls join in on the fun just like last time to pick their favorite things as well. Don’t worry, though, he can’t talk forever right?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA over the Ghoulz can finally rest and get back to work on all the cars they had to leave untouched for the last few weeks…again. First up on deck is our beautiful 1972 Duster. Needing its Dash installed as well as its interior there is still a lot of work left on this car! Additionally, metal work has begun on a host of new cars moving up through the shop, it never stops at Graveyard Carz.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A 1970 Challenger is a special thing, but a B5 Challenger is even more special. With the bumblebee stripe finally added to the car it’s time for the work to really begin. Work begins on all the things that make this 1970 Challenger special, including the headliner, dash, interior and more. With that done it’s time for this beautiful Challenger to get its 440 Six Pack!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The crew is overwhelmed with several restorations at once. From painting stripes, to engine parts, to missing parts on the 71 Charger, tensions are high around the shop. To Make things worse, Mark is obsessed with finding a factory pink Mopar for his granddaughter's 16th birthday.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Mark Worman!
programme.desc: The crew at Graveyard Carz are excited about the pumpkin carving contest, but when a mistake leaves the 'Cuda filled with water, the whole crew has to pay the price. Royal saves the day, but with the carving contest back on the table, where are the pumpkins? Mark has to swallow his pride and accept help from Daren for the contest to go ahead.

programme.desc: After a few incredible days targeting redfish on the inshore waters of Venice, Louisiana, Eric and Moe Newman bring Rush to the nearshore oil rigs — and that’s where things get wild. The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Angry Planet

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The Angry Planet team heads to Africa to climb the steep and very active Nyiragongo Volcano in the Congo that erupted in 2002, sending 125,000 people fleeing for their lives. Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Stormchasing developed in Australia in the same period – the 1990s – as it developed in the American Midwest. In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. This year they stormchase in Newfoundland, site of the hurricane that pulled Mark out of a life-threatening depression.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. Eastern flanks of the volcano to slip by up to two metres, and many houses on the flanks of the volcano experienced structural damage. The eruption also completely destroyed the Rifugio Sapienza, on the southern flank of the volcano. The Rifugio was the site of a cable car station which had previously been destroyed in the 1983 eruption; both have now been rebuilt. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | By Camel to Timbuktu
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. And it really is still possible to travel there by camel caravan, riding the infamous “Ships of the Desert”. Extreme heat, dehydration, possible sand storms, frigid night temperatures and desert predators are our potential companions for the trip.

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E09 - Head to Head

programme.title: Dropped - S05:E10 - Edge of the Storm
programme.desc: As the temperature plummets, the Keefer brothers fight their way down stream through freezing water and strong headwinds as they hope to reach their extraction site before the arctic storm lays claim to it.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: The Greatest Show on Earth is also the most ferocious. Desperate Hours looks at the destructive force of volcanoes and examines the eruptions in Montserrat which devastated half a Caribbean Island, the 1973 eruption on the Icelandic island of Heimaey, the 2010 eruption Eyjafjallajökull which blocked air travel in Europe, the Merapi eruption in Indonesia, and Mount Nyiragongo in Congo, and the super-volcano in Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: When the Earth really moves, it means disaster on an epic scale. Desperate Hours looks at the destructive force of earthquakes and looks at the 2015 Kathmandu earthquake in Nepal, the 2008 Sichuan earthquake in China where an estimated 10,000 children were trapped in collapsed school buildings, a 1960 Puerto Mont earthquake in Chile, the 2010 Port-au-Princ earthquake in Haiti, and the 2005 Kashmir earthquake in Pakistan.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours looks at major epidemics including the African Ebola outbreak in Sudan which eventually led to cases in the United State and England, the Indian Smallpox outbreak in Bihar, the African Cholera outbreak, the SARS outbreak in Guanghzhou China, and the Bird Flu of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E05 - From Inquisitive Bears to Caribou

programme.title: Life on the Edge - S01:E06 - Missing
programme.desc: Charlie Summerville disappears while trying to transport building supplies by boat. Meanwhile, Pat and Connie Harvie have to handle a flood of volcano experts showing up at the most isolated ranch in America.

programme.desc: This tells the tale of a man juggling the stress of his public obligations with the challenges of a failing marriage that's playing out in front of the world. It's a special look at the man fated to become King.

Ironically it's one of the few exploits Mankind undertakes that doesn't occur in nature.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E03 - Orbit
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E05 - Schapbo
programme.desc: John Rambo's ability to decimate enemies all by himself has created some of the most incredible weapon stunts in Hollywood history. We test the reality surrounding these iconic scenes from this blockbuster franchise.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S01:E06 - Terry And The Minigun
programme.desc: Can you really fire a GE Minigun handheld with ammunition held in a backpack (also seen on Predator (1987).
